name: Mizan Supply
legalEntity: AL-MIZAN LLC (operator named in the terms); the shop lists a contact address in Schererville, Indiana.

companyDetails.contactAddress: 228 W. Lincoln Hwy #212, Schererville, IN 46375, United States

coaAccess: Public lot records with shop PDFs and direct links to Freedom Diagnostics Testing PDFs. All 4 sampled shop copies were byte-identical to the lab copies.
dispatchInfo: The shop states dispatch within 1–2 business days and delivery only within the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii. Standard estimates are 3–5 business days outside Alaska and Hawaii and 2–3 weeks for Alaska and Hawaii. Dispatch origin is not stated.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: All 4 sampled lot records link to readable originals at Freedom Diagnostics Testing; product designation, nominal strength, client and lot matched.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: The 4 sampled reports measured 92.9%–122.0% of label; 3 exceeded the nominal amount by more than 10%.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: The 4 reports document LC-MS identity, HPLC-UV purity and net content; none of these reports documents endotoxin, sterility or heavy metals.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The terms name AL-MIZAN LLC and the contact page gives a street address; no registration number or registered office was identified in the shop disclosures read.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: The public policy specifies dispatch and delivery estimates and geographic exclusions; no dispatch location or carrier was stated there.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: Not assessed: prices and product detail pages require sign-in.

strengths: All 4 sampled lot records matched the corresponding lab-hosted certificates.
The shop explains lot-level access and publishes a written US shipping policy.
weaknesses: 3 of 4 sampled reports exceeded the nominal amount by more than 10%.
Prices and product details require sign-in; no dispatch location or registered office was established.
verdict: Mizan Supply's 4 sampled lot records matched readable Freedom Diagnostics Testing reports for product, client and lot. Measured content ranged from 92.9% to 122.0% of label. The shop names its operator and publishes domestic delivery terms, but does not state the dispatch location in its shipping policy.
summary: US-only storefront operated by AL-MIZAN LLC, with lot records available without an account. The public catalog shows listing names, but restricts prices and product details to signed-in users.
notes: The Indiana address is published as a contact address, not as a registered office or dispatch site. The privacy policy mentions card details and payment processors, but does not list supported payment methods. The sample is not a complete report inventory. Dates are the reports' reported dates, also shown as test dates on the shop lot pages. The MZN-2P (T) report uses the identity shorthand GLP TZ; the audit preserves the source designation without expanding it. TB-500 Frag 17-23 and N-Acetyl Selank Amidate are recorded as named, not treated as interchangeable with the full peptide or the unmodified compound.
